Represents a sorted collection of objects, ordered by their execution order and ID. Provides methods for updating and retrieving input actions based on various criteria.

Implements a blocking system for s. When an in this tree is processed and its property is set to true, it blocks the associated s from being used by subsequent s in the same update cycle. files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.BasicTimer
files.Summary: A basic timer class for tracking elapsed and remaining time, supporting pause, resume, stop, cancel, and restart operations.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.ISequenceable
files.Summary: Represents an object that can be updated in a sequence and can create a copy of itself.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.ISequenceableTimedFloat
files.Summary: Defines an interface for a sequenceable timed float value, which can apply its value to a given total.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.Repeater.RepeaterFunc
files.Summary: Delegate that is called after each duration for every repeat. Takes the specified duration and returns the duration for the next cycle.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.Repeater
files.Summary: Represents a sequenceable timer that repeats an action for a specified number of times, with a customizable duration for each repeat cycle.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.Sequencer<T>
files.Summary: Manages and updates sequences of items implementing . Supports starting, updating, cancelling, and restoring sequences.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.SequencerState<T>
files.Summary: Represents the state of a sequencer for a specific type implementing . Holds a copy of the provided sequences.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.SequencerTimedFloat<T>
files.Summary: A sequencer for types implementing . Accumulates and applies timed float values in sequence, updating the total accordingly.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.TimedFloat
files.Summary: Represents a timed float value that can be used in a sequence. Implements to allow for value application and timed updates.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.Tween.TweenFunc
files.Summary: Delegate for the tween function, called with the interpolated value.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.Tween
files.Summary: Represents a generic tween operation that interpolates a value over time.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.TweenColor.TweenFunc
files.Summary: Delegate for the tween function, called with the interpolated color.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.TweenColor
files.Summary: Tween for interpolating between two colors over time.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.TweenFloat.TweenFunc
files.Summary: Delegate for the tween function, called with the interpolated float value.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.TweenFloat
files.Summary: Tween for interpolating between two float values over time.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.TweenInt.TweenFunc
files.Summary: Delegate for the tween function, called with the interpolated integer value.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.TweenInt
files.Summary: Tween for interpolating between two integer values over time.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.TweenRect.TweenFunc
files.Summary: Delegate for the tween function, called with the interpolated rectangle.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.TweenRect
files.Summary: Tween for interpolating between two rectangles over time.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.TweenVector2.TweenFunc
files.Summary: Delegate for the tween function, called with the interpolated Vector2 value.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.Timing.TweenVector2
files.Summary: Tween for interpolating between two Vector2 values over time.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.UI.ControlNode
files.Summary: Represents an abstract base class for UI control nodes, providing core functionality for hierarchy, state, events, and input handling.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.UI.ControlNodeContainer
files.Summary: Represents a container for elements, managing their layout, navigation, and display logic.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.UI.ControlNodeNavigator
files.Summary: Provides navigation and selection logic for a set of instances, supporting keyboard/gamepad navigation and selection events.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.UI.ControlNodeSlider
files.Summary: A slider control node for UI, supporting horizontal or vertical orientation, value range, and user interaction.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.UI.InputFilter
files.Summary: Specifies which input methods a control node responds to in the UI system.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.UI.MouseFilter
files.Summary: Specifies how a control node handles mouse interaction in the UI system.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.UI.RectNode
files.Summary: Represents a rectangular node in the UI hierarchy, supporting anchoring, stretching, margins, and parent/child relationships.

files.Title: ShapeEngine.UI.SelectFilter
files.Summary: Specifies how a control node can be selected in the UI system.
